textHelp.title: MAPFOOTER
textHelp.paragraph1: The mapfooter plugin inserts an HTML footer below the viewer (default position down) with configurable content (htmlCode) and optional stylesheets (cssList), typically for legal notices, links or credits.
textHelp.paragraph2: Use Show/Hide to collapse or expand the footer. Configure htmlCode and cssList to customize content and style. It does not use SidePanel: it is a footer CollapsiblePanel, like mapheader/attributions.
textHelp.screenshot1Alt: Viewer with footer collapsed; the map uses the full lower height
textHelp.screenshot1Description: Example with the footer collapsed: the map reaches the bottom edge and the panel button allows it to be shown again (“Show footer”).
textHelp.screenshot2Alt: Viewer with footer expanded showing the configured HTML
textHelp.screenshot2Description: With the footer expanded, configured HTML and styles appear. Use “Hide footer” to free vertical space for the map.
